_comment: SJVN Khavda 200 MW - project configuration. Read by the data builder (schedule vocabulary, calendar, output paths) and published to the page as DATA.cfg (labels, procurement columns). Never put API tokens here - they live in the gitignored scripts/vl_tokens.json / Actions secrets.
title: SJVN Khavda 200 MW — MIS Dashboard (Live)
name: SJVN Khavda 200 MW

calendar._comment: day 1 of the working-day axis = earliest planned start in VisiLean; Sunday off, as NTPC

_baselineMode_comment: VisiLean carries no baseline dates for this project (checked 04-Sep-2026: 0 of 1,966 rows). 'planned' = treat VisiLean planned dates as the baseline and do NOT flag rows as un-baselined. Switch to 'visilean' once the team sets a baseline in VisiLean.
_activityTypeFromDepartment_comment: no 'Activity Type' custom field in this project; derive Engineering / Procurement - Supply / Procurement - Services / Construction from the department so the EPC bifurcation and S-curve disciplines work
_area_comment: areas are the four 50 MW feeders; VisiLean 'location' is blank on 63% of rows, so the area is read from WBS Level 3 ('Feeder-2 - 50 MW') and the (F2) suffix

departments._comment: VisiLean 'Department' custom field -> dashboard department key

procurementSteps._comment: 'Type of Work' values, in pipeline order; keys are the normalised task names
